inputFields.name: database
inputFields.description: The name of the database where item exits.

inputFields.name: existingVersionOnly
inputFields.description: Indicates whether to return the item even if the requested version does not exist.

inputFields.name: itemId
inputFields.description: The item ID. If both ID and path parameters are specified, the path parameter is ignored.

inputFields.name: path
inputFields.description: The full item path. If both ID and path parameters are specified, the path parameter is ignored.

inputFields.name: requirePresentation
inputFields.description: DEPRECATED. Indicates whether the item required must have presentation.

inputFields.name: version
inputFields.description: The version number of the item.
